Easter and related public holidays (Good Friday, Whit Monday, etc.).

Types

EasterRelatedDays = tuple[GoodFriday: DateTime, EasterSunday: DateTime,
                          EasterMonday: DateTime, Ascension: DateTime,
                          WhitSunday: DateTime, WhitMonday: DateTime]
For a given year, Easter and related days can be stored in a tuple of this type.

Lets

easterRelatedDays: Table[int, EasterRelatedDays] = computeEasterNCo(
    startYearEaster, endYearEaster)
Pre-calculated Easter dates and related public holidays (Good Friday, Whit Monday, etc.) between <startYearEaster> and <endYearEaster>.

Consts

endYearEaster {.intdefine.} = 2200

Pre-calculated Easter dates end in <endYearEaster>.

Assertions:

  • doAssert: endYearEaster >= startYearEaster
startYearEaster {.intdefine.} = 1970

Pre-calculated Easter dates begin in <startYearEaster>

Assertions:

  • doAssert: startYearEaster >= 1583 (the Gregorian calendar came into effect on October 15th, 1582).

Procs

proc holidayAscension(year: int; hour: HourRange = 0; minute: MinuteRange = 0;
                      second: SecondRange = 0; nanosecond: NanosecondRange = 0;
                      zone: Timezone = local()): ?DateTime {....raises: [KeyError],
    tags: [], forbids: [].}
Returns the Ascension day of the year received in parameter (desired time can be specified).

Example:

doAssert:  !holidayAscension(2018) ==~ dateTime(2018, mMay, 10)

proc holidaysRelated2Easter(year: int): ?EasterRelatedDays {....raises: [KeyError],
    tags: [], forbids: [].}
  • Returns none(EasterRelatedDays) if year < startYearEaster or year > endYearEaster.
  • Else, returns the Easter Sunday day and related holidays (Good Friday, Whit Monday, etc.) of the year received in parameter.
